variant.author: spide-r
variant.changelog: Fix minor issue that would cause errors in the plugin log.
variant.description:
This plugin can track the following actions:
- Rescues
- Healing actions
- Status/Buff Application
- Cleanses 
- Heals
- Mitigation
- Provoke
- Shirk

These will be logged in your chat when they are used on your character.
variant.name: Who Did That?
variant.punchline: Actively logs healing, cleanses, buffs, and more. Finally figure out who rescued you.
